scoring_justification: Counts are discrete symmetry-determined structural properties; a run-time recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible as the checker cannot re-execute the full group-theory calculation.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper-reported decomposition from 'Phonon and magnon Raman scattering in the weak ferromagnet FeF3'
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text and validated against solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These integer counts are derived from the group-theoretical calculation of the D3d space group, which is deterministic and publicly verifiable.

outputs.description: Phonon irreducible representation counts for optical zone‑center modes, with Raman and infrared activity classification.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the integer counts per irrep exactly against the paper‑reported decomposition (1 Γ₁⁺, 2 Γ₂⁺, 3 Γ₃⁺, 2 Γ₁⁻, 2 Γ₂⁻, 4 Γ₃⁻) and verifies that raman_active sums to 4 (1 Γ₁⁺ + 3 Γ₃⁺). Because these are discrete symmetry‑determined values, an exact match policy is appropriate.
